head: d02653545ef7bf4b905eb69d87aace12ab9f49ea
findings: EnemyCallsigns assigns and retains display names. killFeedEnemy source lookup is read-only. The name is written to combat.kill victim/killer display metadata; projectile/officer source-name consumers also use it only as attribution.

recordStreamKill still passes the same type/health/closeCall/highlight values to applyPerformance, and the same killCause/headshot/nowMs arguments to chat.kill. StreamKill numeric records and sequence/cause fields are unchanged.

performance_stream.ts, chat_moderation.ts, live_stream.ts, stream_account.ts, chat_mode.ts, stream_session.ts and stream_chat_view.ts are unchanged. StreamSession consumes unchanged crowd.streamKills, without callsign names.

Presentation seam: RogueliteView passes scoreboard.displayedRows instead of full roster length to existing setScoreboardRows. This sizes the Tab moderation/chat backing and visible-message capacity; it does not dispatch chat actions, change moderation outcomes, or update audience counts.
Page Up/Down add scoreboard navigation only after existing chat actions are handled. No chat bindings or command payloads changed.
decision: Record in PR and move on; do not retune audience or weaken assertions. First-run playability is not a merge gate per user instruction (dropped 2026-10-14).
